Problem: Route and Total_Stops contained missing values.
Solution: Removed the incomplete record after checking missing values.

Problem: Flight duration was stored as text containing hours and minutes.
Solution: Converted duration into numerical minutes using regular expressions.

Problem: Journey dates and departure and arrival times were stored as text.
Solution: Extracted day, month, hour and minute features.

Problem: Airline, Source and Destination contained text categories.
Solution: Used OneHotEncoder to convert categorical variables into numerical features.

Problem: Numerical features had different value ranges.
Some flight prices were much higher than average.
Solution: Kept valid high-priced flights instead of removing them blindly.

Problem: Different machine learning models produced different prediction errors.
Solution: Compared four regression models using MAE, RMSE and R2 Score.
